# Atlas Heatworks

Atlas Heatworks is an employee-owned heat-pump installer serving homes and small commercial buildings across Alder County. Product specifications belong to the [Aster Series Product Catalog](aster-series-product-catalog.md), while service priorities belong to the Customer Support and Warranty Policy.
